svg.title: Mahalanobis distance is Euclidean distance after whitening
svg.desc: Two panels. On the left, a correlated elliptical point cloud with one- and two-sigma contours and two marked points A and B joined to the centre by lines of equal length, both on a dashed circle: A points along the ellipse's long axis, B across it. On the right the same cloud after whitening is round, and the same two points now sit on dashed circles of clearly different radii, B roughly twice as far from the centre as A.
svg.text: Mahalanobis distance is Euclidean distance measured after whitening
A and B are equally far from the mean by ruler. A lies along the direction the data already varies in, so it is unremarkable;
B lies across it, and ends up 2.2× further out once whitened. H-score weighs class centroids this way, not by ruler.
